title: Nanonets Prediction
description: Top-level prediction object returned by the Nanonets OCR API.

label.description: Label name corresponding to a field or table header configured in the model.

label_id.description: Unique identifier for the label as defined in the model.

type.description: Indicates whether the prediction is a field or a table header.

xmin.description: Left edge of the bounding box.

ymin.description: Top edge of the bounding box.

xmax.description: Right edge of the bounding box.

ymax.description: Bottom edge of the bounding box.

ocr_text.description: Predicted value associated with the label.

validation_status.description: Present and equal to 'failed' when an approval rule did not pass; absent on success.

validation_message.description: Reason a label-level validation rule failed.

page_no.description: Zero-indexed page number in the document.

cells.description: Cell predictions when this prediction is a table.
